segments.text:
V. 34.
Simeon bleſſed them—Ioſeph and Mary. This child is ſet for the fall and riſing again of many—That is, He will be a ſavour of death to ſome, to Unbelievers; a ſavour of life to others, to Believers: And for a ſign which ſhall be ſpoken againſt—A Sign from GOD, yet rejected of Men: But the Time for declaring this at large, was not yet come: That the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed—The Event will be, that by Means of that Contradiction, the inmoſt Thoughts of many, whether good or bad, will be made manifeſt.
